attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

attacks.name: Overpower
steps: After this attack is resolved, place this character within |!range| 1 of the target.
|!wild| |*Throw|: If the target character is Size 2 or less, before |!damage| is dealt this character may throw it |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Haymaker
superPowers.body: The next Strike or Overpower attack made by this character this turn adds three dice to its attack roll.

superPowers.name: Inured to Pain
superPowers.body: If this character would suffer |!damage|, it may use this superpower. Reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1.

superPowers.name: Aggressive
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, if this character suffered |!damage|, it may advance |!range_small| toward the attacking character.
